initial_condition: The beta-weighted Gaussian projection onto the first 21 longitudinal modes for each transverse index 0 through 16 defines a finite continuous initial pressure. Remove only the global constant mode and normalize each source to unit acoustic energy. Initial velocity is zero; every propagation grid receives exact cell averages of the same continuous field.
receiver_definition: Normalized continuous Gaussian pressure averages, with exact integrated cell weights for finite-volume reconstruction.
sampling: Equally weighted samples at t=j/80, j=0,...,640; each cumulative interval includes both endpoints.
layout_rationale: Two sources on the left and one on the right, with two receivers on each side, give six same-side and six opposite-side channels. All positions differ from the original layout and no source and receiver are collocated. Reflected cavity arrivals remain part of every trace.
selection_rule: Layouts, grids, ranks, windows, bandwidth and matching thresholds are fixed within the computational study. Report every prescribed model and channel.
